name: ACP (Agent Client)
summary: The Agent Client Protocol standardizes how code editors and IDEs talk to coding agents, similar in spirit to the Language Server Protocol. Local agents run as editor subprocesses and speak JSON-RPC over stdio; remote transports over HTTP or WebSocket are in progress. It is jointly governed by Zed and JetBrains.
facts: JSON-RPC over stdio; HTTP/WebSocket in progress
